digest.component_or_area: LLM overlap detection and enrichment drain system
propositions: The cross-ticket overlap detector implementation (2,280 LOC) is removed entirely: modules, CLI, prompts, schemas, calibration scripts, and related tests.

Four event type names (TICKET_DIGEST, ENQUEUE_ENRICH, CLAIM_ENRICH, DONE_ENRICH) are retained in _NON_REPLAY_KNOWN_TYPES and EVENT_TYPES with 'retired producer' comments to preserve ~105k historical events.
The create-time same-title duplicate journal is re-enabled via suggest_duplicate_tickets=true in rebar.toml, providing advisory warnings without blocking creates.
All write-path enrichment hooks (event_append.py:385-387, push.py:590-596, plan_review/attest.py:216-233, plan_review/__init__.py:600-612) are removed.
Configuration keys (13 REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_* env vars, [llm] overlap_* settings) are deleted; leftover config is silently ignored under existing schema.
Retired event types still parse, survive compaction, and pass fsck validation with no tombstones or schema/types.py edits.
